topic.label: Capital Markets and Exchanges
topic.desc: Where securities trade: exchanges and trading venues, market structure, order types and execution concepts, clearing and settlement, indices, and trading platforms. Context only; no execution.

concepts.label: Clearing, Settlement and Custody
concepts.desc: What happens after a trade: clearing houses, settlement cycles, custody and prime brokerage.

concepts.label: Exchanges and Trading Venues
concepts.desc: Stock, futures and options exchanges, alternative trading systems, dark pools and their listing rules and hours.

concepts.label: Indices and Benchmarks
concepts.desc: Market indices such as the S&P 500, how they are built, weighted and rebalanced, and index funds that track them.

concepts.label: Trading Platforms and Market Data
concepts.desc: Brokerages, trading platforms, terminals and market data feeds, and what each provides.

concepts.label: Market Structure and Orders
concepts.desc: Order types, order books, bid-ask spread, market makers, liquidity and best execution.

skills.label: Trade Lifecycle Tracer
skills.desc: Traces a trade from order to settlement, naming each party and step.

skills.label: Venue Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a trading venue's role, listing rules, hours and which instruments trade there.

skills.label: Index Methodology Explainer
skills.desc: Explains how an index is constructed, weighted and rebalanced.

skills.label: Market Data Explainer
skills.desc: Explains market data types (quotes, trades, bars, depth) and their sources.

skills.label: Platform Comparator
skills.desc: Compares brokerages and trading platforms by instruments, fees, data and API access.

skills.label: Liquidity Assessor
skills.desc: Assesses an instrument's liquidity from spread, depth and volume.

skills.label: Order Type Explainer
skills.desc: Explains order types and which to use for a goal, with risks.

mcp.name: Alpaca MCP
mcp.desc: Alpaca MCP server: stock, options and crypto market data, account positions and order placement through a brokerage API.

mcp.name: Polygon MCP
mcp.desc: Polygon.io MCP server: market data for stocks, options, indices, forex and crypto, aggregates, trades, quotes, reference data and financials.

mcp.name: Twelve Data MCP
mcp.desc: Twelve Data MCP server: real time and historical prices for stocks, forex, crypto, ETFs and indices, technical indicators.
